name: docusaurus-dgmo-showcase
description: Standalone Docusaurus site that renders every dgmo chart type, deployed to GitHub Pages. NOT the test fixture — a clean minimal project that consumes the published packages, because the eval-based Docusaurus SSG is sensitive to the test fixture's dependency tree.

scripts.start: if command -v claim-port >/dev/null 2>&1; then claim-port 4342 || { [ $? -eq 3 ] || exit 1; exit 0; }; fi; docusaurus start --port 4342
